reason: I already have Xfix and Homico, and they cost me nothing to look at. I do not see what a new middleman adds, and a pilot that is not even open yet in Tbilisi is a lot to hand my whole refit to.
objection: Who checks the crews, and what happens to my money if one of them walks off halfway through the job? The page leaves both of those blank.
would_change_my_mind: A named verification process and a clear written promise that I get my money back, or the job finished by someone else, if a crew stops mid-job, plus proof that the crews are cheaper than the ones I can find myself.
